summary: Pilgrim's Pride Corporation and subsidiary Pilgrim's Europe Finance PLC closed a private offering of $500 million 4.750% senior notes due January 23, 2034, per an 8-K filed September 23, 2026. Interest is payable annually each January 23, beginning January 23, 2027; the unsecured notes rank equally with other senior unsecured debt under a Citibank, N.A., London Branch indenture. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including funding consideration for the previously announced Walkers Deli Sausage acquisition. This is a routine financing, not a special-situation event. Watch for acquisition closing timing and leverage.
